description: List recent click events for a short link (time, location, device).

end.description: Range end, ISO date/datetime. Defaults to now when only `start` is given.

start.description: Range start, ISO date or datetime (e.g. 2026-08-03 or 2026-08-03T14:00:00Z). Use start/end together for a fixed window instead of the rolling `days` look-back.

name: get_short_link_activity
